notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Here's another patch to fix some issues found on the game:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes the player lost control during the organize items minigame on Mother Love's storage room
[*]Fixed Mother Love's eyes during some parts of the cutscene on her office when you decide to tell her you're here with Courage
[*]Drawing on the first Free Talk with Mother Love weren't showing but now they are
[*]The OK button from any tutorial popup can be clicked with mouse controls instead of just enter
[*]A clearer dialog on how to interact with the items on Simulation building
[*]Before you get to control Courage from the first time on her room, she explains keyboard and gamepad controls
[/list]

notes.title: fixed small issue using mouse on response buttons
notes.notes: fixed small issue where if you had the mouse pointer already appearing when a response button (that buttons of decision when you're having a conversation) appeared, it was not getting highlighted

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed some issues to help you have a better experience:
[list]
[*]Now you have to press shift+S to skip conversations(using just S key could be a little dangerous)
[*]Correctly positioned Courage on her first free talk with you on her computer
[*]Fixed a mouse control issue where the cursor would sometimes select more than one option during conversations
[*]Players who choose to pass dialog by clicking on the yellow arrow on conversation panel cannot advance to the next line of dialog if a tutorial popup is showing
[*]Courage now explains  about the pause menu before you get to control her (some players found the controls unintuitive)
[/list]

Also, I forgot to mention, but ever since the latest BIG update, I had solved an issue where the player couldn't type text with S without starting a skip

notes.title: Game isn't episodic anymore. Enjoy Courage's tale to the end! And there's a demo
notes.notes:
When I first launched the game on Steam, it had an episodic format (and only ep. 1 was available). Some devs advised me episodic games won't sell very well.
That made me sad, but, just like Courage, I decided to confront this issue and not give up until the very end.

Now, I'm proud to announce "Glisten to your heart: The courage within you" is not an episodic game anymore. It tells a full story, which came to an emotional conclusion for Sam, Andrea, Courage and of course... You.
I had redesigned the game to make perfect endings (yes, there is more than one possible ending), made new cutscenes, made the affection system have an impact in the story too, made story alterations... I even had to remove Andrea's mom from the story, but if you decide to follow Andrea's route, you'll even encounter a new surprise character at the end.

This has been an emotional journey for me, as a developer, and I hope you'll feel the same way when playing the full tale of Courage.
Please enjoy my new game and don't ever forget to Glisten to your heart, no matter what.

Oh, and a free demo is now available too! With it, you can have a great impression on what's on the full game. Here's what's in it:

[list][*]In terms of story, it covers a day in the life of Courage until she finally decides to go to our world, Virtuanland. It's a good way to feel the premise of the story[/list]
[list][*]It covers 2 of the 4 minigames ("Talk to all" and "Choose correct thoughts" are not included until later in the game) found on the full game[/list]
[list][*]You can make 2 (or 3, depending on your choices) of the main game's big decisions[/list]
[list][*]You'll get to meet 5 of the main characters and will have an idea of what should Courage do to complete her mission[/list]
[list][*]You'll help your first virtuan (even though he's not technically a virtuan. You'll see xD)[/list]
[list][*]All your progress can be transferred to the full game[/list]
